name: – Vlad Vasile-Voiculescu – § 26 – Am 16
title: REPORT on the implementation of Europe’s Beating Cancer Plan
part_text: 26. Recalls that the national competences of Member States prevail in the effective implementation of the WHO FCTC and the WHO Protocol to Eliminate Illicit Trade in Tobacco Products, in line with Member States’ competences and in application of FCTC Article 5.3 and its guidelines on protection of public health policymaking from the vested interests of the tobacco industry; recalls Parliament’s rejection of the EU Council recommendation on smoke- and aerosol-free environments;
